method: requirements-check-1 (Sonnet 5 judge + Sonnet 5 check; disagreements unknown; quotes verified)

apiKey.keyFor: An AI model provider key (default is OpenAI with an empty key); the chat assistant does not work until one is supplied

evidence.quote: There you can configure models, API key.

checkNote: Defaults are pref("extensions.zotero.kern.apiURL", "https://api.openai.com/v1/") with pref("extensions.zotero.kern.apiKey", ""), so the default setup needs the user's own key. I agree with 'required' but the reviewer's keyFor overstates it, because keyless local models are also possible. The code has the preset `{ name: "Ollama (Local)", apiURL: "http://localhost:11434/v1/", ... placeholder: "(optional)" }` at kern.js:47321, which settles local = yes. The seerai.com quote the reviewer cited is not local, so the Ollama line is the right evidence.
